*Low Tide, Morecambe*

The sea goes out so far you'd think
it meant to leave for good,
the way you said you'd only be a minute
and the kettle boiled twice.

Gulls stitch the wet sand shut.
A dog runs at nothing, delighted.
Somewhere past the lighthouse
the water is deciding to come back.

I keep your scarf in the glovebox.
It still smells of the bakery on Euston Road
and that cold October
we didn't know was the last one.

— for M., 2026
